channels.name: RF Carrier (13.56 MHz)
channels.direction: PCD → field; PICC receives via inductive coupling
channels.purpose: Continuous unmodulated 13.56 MHz carrier that powers the PICC and serves as the synchronous clock reference.
channels.active_levels: Field strength 1.5..7.5 A/m at operating volume

channels.name: PCD→PICC modulation
channels.purpose: Carries 7-bit short frames, standard frames, and anti-collision bit-frames as envelope changes.
channels.active_levels: 100% ASK Modified Miller (Type A) or 10% ASK NRZ-L (Type B)

channels.name: PICC→PCD load modulation
channels.purpose: Carries ATQA, UID-CLn+BCC, SAK, ATS, T=CL replies as 847.5 kHz subcarrier sidebands.

channels.name: PCD Host Bus (SPI/I2C/UART)
channels.purpose: Application path between host MCU and PCD chip.

channels.name: PCD IRQ
channels.purpose: Asynchronous interrupt indicating frame received / TX complete / error.

global_signals.name: 13.56 MHz RF carrier
global_signals.purpose: Shared synchronous time base for PCD-PICC system.

handshake_pairs.name: REQA_ATQA
handshake_pairs.rule: PCD REQA (7-bit) → PICC ATQA (16-bit) within fdt_listen.

handshake_pairs.name: AC_SELECT
handshake_pairs.rule: PCD SEL+NVB → PICC UID-CLn+BCC. Full SELECT → SAK + CRC_A.

handshake_pairs.name: RATS_ATS
handshake_pairs.rule: PCD RATS → PICC ATS within FWT.

handshake_pairs.name: HLTA
handshake_pairs.rule: PCD HLTA → PICC silent ACK → HALT.

handshake_pairs.name: S_DESELECT
handshake_pairs.rule: PCD S(DESELECT) → PICC S(DESELECT) ACK → HALT.

dependency_graph.common_rule: PCD transmits the carrier continuously; PICC powers itself from the carrier and replies only within fdt_listen of a recognised PCD command. There is no PICC-initiated traffic.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: PCD command framing depends on the current PICC state. Anti-collision depends on bitwise PICC replies. Layer 4 traffic depends on a successful RATS/ATS handshake.

power_pins.name: PCD AVDD
power_pins.purpose: Analog supply for PCD oscillator / modulator / RX (typ 3.3 V).

power_pins.name: PCD DVDD
power_pins.purpose: Digital supply for PCD logic (typ 3.3 V or 1.8 V).

power_pins.name: PICC LA / LB
power_pins.purpose: PICC antenna coil terminals; no external VCC pin.

ordering_rules.byte_ordering_on_wire_type_a: Bytes in protocol order; bits LSB-first; one odd-parity bit per byte.
ordering_rules.byte_ordering_on_wire_type_b: Bytes in protocol order; bits LSB-first; start bit + 8 data + stop bit + 2-ETU EGT.

ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)
